headline: HAEi issues updated patient guidance on oral-modality options
summary: Patient advocacy organization published updated guidance acknowledging emerging oral on-demand options. Neutral tone; frames all modalities as valid under physician guidance (illustrative).

headline: Updated EU HAE prevalence estimate: 1 in 50,000 to 1 in 67,000
summary: European HAE registry published refined prevalence estimates based on diagnostic data improvements. Suggests the addressable population has been modestly under-counted (illustrative).

headline: US Hereditary Angioedema Association launches patient-choice initiative
summary: Campaign emphasizes patient autonomy in modality selection. Aligns with positioning of emerging oral on-demand options as choice-expansion rather than substitution (illustrative).

headline: World Allergy Organization HAE treatment update (2026 revision)
summary: Revised guidance includes new section on oral on-demand considerations. Notes evidence base is still emerging at time of publication; explicit call for real-world evidence generation (illustrative).

headline: UK NICE initiates review of HAE treatment landscape
summary: NICE announced a horizon-scanning assessment of emerging HAE therapies, including oral on-demand options. Signals potential for formal evaluation cycles in 2026 to 2027 (illustrative).

headline: US HAE registry reports rising adolescent diagnosis rate
summary: Annual registry update noted a 12% year-over-year increase in adolescent HAE diagnoses, attributed to broader screening rather than actual incidence change (illustrative). Increases near-term pediatric addressable population.

headline: HAEi global patient survey 2025 results published
summary: Patient-reported pain points prioritize treatment convenience, speed of relief, and needle avoidance. Directly supports oral on-demand positioning. Will be referenced frequently through launch cycles (illustrative).

headline: German G-BA issues benefit assessment framework update for rare diseases
summary: Procedural update clarifying evidence requirements for novel-mechanism rare disease therapies. Relevant for oral on-demand assessment pathways (illustrative).

headline: Pharvaris signs ex-US manufacturing partnership with a leading CDMO
summary: Pre-launch commercial manufacturing capacity secured ahead of anticipated deucrictibant approval. Capacity commitments suggest confidence in RAPIDe-3 readout and rolling-filing pathway (illustrative).

headline: BioCryst extends Orladeyo Japan partnership with Torii Pharmaceutical through 2030
summary: Renewed exclusive distribution agreement reinforces capital-light international strategy in Japan. Maintains incumbent footprint as oral entrants prepare for the market (illustrative).

headline: Takeda acquires regional specialty pharmacy network in DACH region
summary: Tightens patient access infrastructure for Takhzyro across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Defensive distribution play ahead of oral on-demand entrants (illustrative).

headline: G-BA grants positive benefit rating for Andembry in long-term HAE prophylaxis
summary: G-BA assessment recognises a non-quantifiable additional benefit versus standard of care for adult patients on long-term prophylaxis. Sets up favorable price negotiation under AMNOG (illustrative).
timeToReimbursement: ~6 months from assessment to AMNOG-negotiated price

headline: NICE issues restricted recommendation for Dawnzera (donidalorsen)
summary: NICE recommends Dawnzera only for patients with documented inadequate response to existing prophylactic therapies. Decision frames antisense mechanism as a second-line option for now (illustrative).
timeToReimbursement: ~3 months from NICE recommendation to NHS access

headline: HAS publishes mixed transparency opinion on extended-release oral HAE prophylaxis
summary: HAS Transparency Commission assigned a moderate ASMR rating (IV) citing limited comparative evidence versus existing oral options. Reimbursement granted but at a price discount versus benchmark (illustrative).
timeToReimbursement: ~9 months from opinion to CEPS price agreement

headline: Ionis and Otsuka expand Dawnzera co-promotion into key EU markets
summary: Ionis and Otsuka announced an expansion of their existing US Dawnzera co-promotion to cover Germany, France, and Italy. Otsuka takes lead on commercial execution while Ionis retains medical affairs lead and remains booking party in the US (illustrative).

headline: Astria licenses APAC rights for STAR-0215 to undisclosed regional partner
summary: Astria announced an exclusive APAC licensing agreement covering Japan, Korea, and Taiwan for STAR-0215. Astria retains US, EU, and Latin America commercial rights. Partner takes development costs in territory (illustrative).

headline: CSL Behring expands fill-finish capacity for Andembry in Switzerland
summary: CSL Behring announced a $180M capex commitment to expand fill-finish capacity at its Bern facility, dedicated to Andembry and other recombinant pipeline assets. Operational target H2 2026, with a secondary line earmarked for surge demand scenarios (illustrative).

headline: Pharma Inc signs EU co-promotion deal for Ekterly with specialty pharma
summary: Pharma Inc announced a multi-country EU co-promotion agreement with an undisclosed specialty pharma partner for Ekterly launch. Pharma Inc retains booking while the partner co-promotes across five major EU markets (illustrative).

headline: BioCryst acquires HAE-focused diagnostic startup for $42M
summary: BioCryst announced the acquisition of a small US-based diagnostics company developing a rapid HAE attack severity assessment tool. Strategic intent: pair with Orladeyo and Berotralstat-class assets to support attack-management decisions and reinforce stickiness with prescribers (illustrative).

headline: Pharvaris in-licenses next-gen B2 antagonist series from undisclosed biotech
summary: Pharvaris disclosed in-licensing of a preclinical B2 receptor antagonist series for HAE and other bradykinin-mediated indications. Provides pipeline optionality beyond deucrictibant and reinforces the company's commitment to the B2 mechanism (illustrative).
dealValue: $18M upfront plus up to $220M in milestones

headline: NICE begins full technology appraisal for sebetralstat in on-demand HAE
summary: Formal appraisal could establish the first NICE-endorsed oral on-demand option. Outcome will directly benchmark comparable mechanisms including Ekterly (illustrative).

headline: Andembry outperforms Takhzyro & Orladeyo in Germany and Japan post-launch
summary: First 5 months data (exact figures undisclosed). Fastest HAE long-term prophylaxis launch on record in both markets, sets a benchmark for novel-mechanism launch velocity (illustrative).

headline: Ekterly Phase III data supports accelerated US filing strategy
summary: Robust primary endpoint performance enables priority review application pathway. Commercial teams signalling H2 2027 US launch readiness, with EU filing to follow (illustrative).
